about: Every illustration the Mind space uses (docs/mind-plan.md §19, docs/mind-art.md). Generated by hand in the Gemini app, saved into inbox/ as <id>.png, then imported. The prompt sheet is prototypes/mind-space/art.html. Kurenai was redesigned on 24 October 2026 (docs/mind-plan.md §19.1); her earlier green-background edit (inbox/mind.base.kurenai.png) is no longer used. All 31 made on 24 October 2026, every one in Gemini except mind.card.beauvoir (ChatGPT).

styles.colour: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached style reference (the tall woman in the white coat) exactly — high-quality modern anime illustration, light-novel cover quality, fine clean lineart with thin tapered lines, soft cel shading with gentle gradients, detailed fabric folds, rich but slightly muted colours, natural slender proportions, soft even studio lighting from the front-left. Do NOT draw the woman from the style reference; use her only for the art style.
styles.manga: STYLE: A single black-and-white Japanese manga panel, as printed in a weekly shounen or slice-of-life magazine: crisp black ink lineart, screentone dot shading, solid black hair spots, white highlights, no colour and no grey wash. Same character designs as the attached character sheets.
styles.bg: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached style reference (painterly anime background art, as in a high-budget TV anime or visual novel): soft painted lighting, clean perspective, gentle depth of field. Do NOT draw the woman from the style reference; use her only for the art style.
styles.cast: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached cast references exactly (the young man in the long grey coat and the schoolgirl in the navy blazer): clean modern anime visual-novel sprite art, even medium-weight clean outlines, simple two-tone cel shading, flat readable colour areas, minimal pattern and ornament, natural proportions, soft even lighting from the front-left. Do NOT draw the people in the references; use them only for the art style.

rules: Never any text: no letters, no Japanese, no speech bubbles, no captions, no signatures, no logos. Signs, menus and posters are blank or show pictures only. (All text is added later as a live layer.)
Keep each character's design identical to their sheet: hair, eyes, uniform, colours.
Save each result into art-source/mind/inbox/ with the exact file name shown, as PNG at the highest resolution Gemini offers.

ren.name: 藤宮 蓮 (Fujimiya Ren)
ren.role: Kurenai's colleague and the space's sceptic: takes the other side, plays your opponent, and changes his mind out loud when an argument beats him.
ren.look: a Japanese man in his late twenties, slim and tall (a little taller than the woman in the style reference), relaxed posture with a faintly amused, half-lidded expression; slightly messy ash-black hair, collar length, with a soft side part, a few strands falling over his right eye, the underside and tips tinted a muted wisteria purple; calm grey-violet eyes; a single small earring on his left ear: a wisteria-blossom charm with a short pale-purple silk tassel; a long charcoal-grey scholar's coat with a high mandarin collar, worn open, its lining a muted wisteria purple with a faint fine geometric line pattern, the sleeves turned back once at the cuffs; under it a fitted black high-neck sweater, a dark slate waistcoat with a thin silver watch chain, slim dark trousers, polished black leather boots; a thin silver ring on his right hand; no glasses, no hat

kurenai.name: 紅 (Kurenai)
kurenai.role: Your guide and the Socratic questioner, and the app's mascot. Redesigned (24 October 2026) to match the cast: the same identity, far less ornament.
kurenai.look: a Japanese woman in her mid-twenties, calm, perceptive and gently amused; long straight black hair to the waist with a violet underlayer showing at the ends, soft side-swept bangs; one small crimson five-petal flower hair ornament on the right side of her head, with no tassel; rose-crimson eyes; a plain white knee-length lab coat worn open, its lining a muted crimson, sleeves turned back once at the cuffs, no patterns, no badges, no writing; under it a simple black high-collared knee-length dress with a single crimson button at the collar and no slit; black tights; black ankle boots with a low heel; holding a slim plain dark tablet; average height, natural proportions, a little shorter than the young man in the reference

batches.title: Character sheets
batches.why: Ren's sheet, then Kurenai's redesign (drawn in the style of Ren's base pose and Akari's sprite, so she matches the cast). Everything else of theirs is drawn from these, so regenerate until you like the design.

batches.title: Base poses
batches.why: Ren's two full-body poses and Kurenai's new one, on flat green. Every expression is edited onto the base image, so the body never moves.

batches.title: Expressions
batches.why: Edits of the base poses: upload the base image to Gemini, then give the prompt. Only the face may change. Ren's seven, then the three Kurenai's design asks for.

batches.title: Dialogue backgrounds
batches.why: Where the Socratic dialogues happen. Empty of people: characters are layered on top.

batches.title: Thought-experiment theatre
batches.why: The trolley and the footbridge (frames 32t–32u). Calm, never frightening; the people in the dilemma are a live layer, not painted in.

batches.title: Philosopher cards
batches.why: Small portraits for the cards (32ac). Respectful interpretations from their surviving portraits and busts.

batches.title: Later scenes
batches.why: For the other thought experiments (the experience machine, the ship of Theseus, the Chinese room). No rush: make them when those scenes are written.

assets.prompt: A character reference sheet for an original character: {look:ren}. On one plain light-grey background, side by side: full-body front view, full-body three-quarter view and full-body back view, all standing in a relaxed neutral pose at the same scale, plus three head close-ups on the right (neutral, a dry amused half-smile, one eyebrow raised in scepticism). Consistent proportions and colours across every view. No text, no labels, no colour swatches with writing.

A character reference sheet for an original character: {look:kurenai}. On one plain light-grey background, side by side: full-body front view, full-body three-quarter view and full-body back view, all standing in a relaxed neutral pose at the same scale, plus three head close-ups on the right (neutral, a soft warm smile, curious with eyebrows slightly raised). Consistent proportions and colours across every view. Keep the design simple: no circuit patterns, belts, harnesses, chains, badges or extra jewellery. No text, no labels, no colour swatches with writing.

Ren from the attached character sheet ({look:ren}), drawn as a visual-novel character sprite: full body, standing, body turned slightly to his right (three-quarter view) with his face toward the viewer, holding a closed, worn dark-green hardcover book against his side in his left hand with a ribbon bookmark hanging out, right hand relaxed in his trouser pocket, neutral calm expression with the mouth closed, eyes open looking at the viewer. Centred, the whole figure visible from the top of the hair to the boots, with a small margin above the head and below the feet; nothing cropped. Background: one flat solid pure green colour (#00FF00), completely even, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no green anywhere on the character.

The same character in the same style, scale and framing as the attached sprite, in a second pose: full body, standing, facing the viewer more directly, his right hand raised at chest height with a plain silver coin balanced on the knuckle of his index finger as if about to flip it (no markings on the coin), his left hand holding the closed book at his hip, neutral calm expression with the mouth closed, eyes on the viewer. Identical clothing, hair and colours. Whole figure visible, nothing cropped. Background: one flat solid pure green colour (#00FF00), completely even, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no green anywhere on the character.

Kurenai from the attached character sheet ({look:kurenai}), drawn as a visual-novel character sprite at the same scale as the young man in the attached reference: full body, standing, body turned slightly to her left (three-quarter view) with her face toward the viewer, holding the slim dark tablet against her side in her right hand, left hand relaxed at her side, neutral calm expression with the mouth closed, eyes open looking at the viewer. Centred, the whole figure visible from the top of the hair to the boots, with a small margin above the head and below the feet; nothing cropped. Background: one flat solid pure green colour (#00FF00), completely even, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no green anywhere on the character.

Background art: a quiet scholar's study in an old building in the afternoon: tall dark-wood bookshelves full of books with blank spines, a large arched window on the right with soft daylight and a hint of a wisteria vine outside, a long reading table with a brass lamp, an open blank notebook and a cup of tea, a chalkboard on the back wall with only simple diagrams (arrows, a tree of boxes), no writing. Muted warm wood with soft purple shadows. Camera at standing eye level, horizon at about 45% of the height, the floor area in the centre left open so characters can stand there. No people. No text anywhere.
